_comment: Release notes for Settings → About → App version & updates (GSM-144).
A committed asset, not a fetch: GeoSafe is a pure client with no backend,
and a changelog that needs a server cannot be read offline.
Schema — releases MUST be ordered newest first:
version : the pubspec version WITHOUT the build number (e.g. 1.0.15).
The entry whose version matches the running build is labelled
'Current' by the screen; do not hard-code that here.
date    : optional display date, e.g. '10 JAN 2026'. Omit if unknown —
an invented date is worse than no date.
sections: [{ heading, body }] — the ticket asks for new features, bug
fixes and security updates as separate headings.
NOTE: no release notes have been written for any shipped GeoSafe build.
The list below is intentionally empty rather than filled with invented
changelog copy; the screen falls back to naming the running version and
saying plainly that its notes have not been recorded. Add entries here.
